author: DeAnna Poole
title: Measles cases reported in Warren County - NewsBreak
text:
By DeAnna Poole ,
7 hours ago
Just one day after the state of Pennsylvania announced two measles-related deaths, the PA Department of Health is reporting three cases of measles in Warren County.
On Tuesday, August 25, state health officials said that two unvaccinated people in Lancaster County died after being infected with measles.
Measles cases reported in Mercer County These are the country's first measles-related deaths this year and the first in Pennsylvania in more than thirty years.
U.S. Secretary of Health and Human Services Robert F. Kennedy Jr. addressed these deaths at an event in Florida on Wednesday, claiming Pennsylvania did not cooperate when asked to provide details about the deaths to the CDC.
“The only state that won’t cooperate with us is Pennsylvania and we can't get any information. The press is all covering this as if those measles deaths actually happened but nobody's doing, sort of the little bit of critical inquiry to find out,” Kennedy said. "We're trying to figure out who those deaths were and where they actually happened."
The Pennsylvania Department of Health said they will not release additional details that could identify the people who died in the interest of privacy.
